title: BECE Basic Technology & Computer Science - Computer Science - Storage
subject: Computer Science

questions.explain: RAM stands for Random Access Memory, the computer's primary volatile memory.
questions.subject: Computer Science

questions.q: Which of these is a 'Non-volatile' memory (data is retained when power is off)?
questions.explain: ROM (Read-Only Memory) is non-volatile; it keeps its contents without power. RAM loses data when power is cut.
questions.subject: Computer Science

questions.q: Which storage device typically has the largest capacity?
questions.explain: HDDs typically store Terabytes (TB) of data, while DVDs store GBs and CDs store MBs. Floppy disks store mere KBs/MBs.
questions.subject: Computer Science

questions.q: Which of the following is the smallest unit of data?
questions.explain: Order of size: Bit < Byte < KB < MB < GB < TB. Among options, Kilobyte is smallest.
questions.subject: Computer Science
